item.title: About
item.description: About me I am a researcher and engineer by training. I am broadely interested in different kinds of problems and in the pursuit of which I end up learning from different traditional disciplines of knowledge. I am at present associated with Information and Communication Technology for Development (ICTD) lab at IIT Delhi. Here I am working on building the Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) for ecological restoration and improving welfare of socially marginalised people.
